title: Scaffolding Blueprint

## 📖 What's this mod?

***

This mod add 1 item: The Scaffolding Blueprint. Used to quickly copy or retract a scaffolding structure and quickly deploy it elsewhere

How to use:

*   Right click a scaffolding structure with the empty blueprint will copy it. Shift-right click to retract it.
*   Right click with a filled blueprint onto a block will place the preview of the structure there. Shift-right click to confirm and place the structure or place it directly at the aim location if you haven't set the preview (You will need to have enough scaffolding block in survival mode). Right click in the air to clear the preview.

There are 2 config options available:

*   **max\_scaffolding\_blocks**: Control the maximum number of scaffolding blocks the blueprint can hold (Default: 128).
*   **consume\_blueprint\_after\_placing**: Whether the blueprint will become empty after using or will it hold the design to be placed again (Default: true).
